dakura_origins.race.humano.name: Human
dakura_origins.race.humano.description: Before scales, wings and pacts with the night, there was only the Human. Born of clay and stubbornness, they carry neither blessing nor curse: only their own hands, a pickaxe and the will to shape the world block by block. Where other races depend on blood, the Human depends on choice. They are where every legend begins, the wanderer who lights the first torch in the dark and, against all odds, survives the first night.
dakura_origins.race.humano.trait.0: No advantages, no disadvantages: you are exactly as the world made you.
dakura_origins.race.humano.trait.1: Free of weaknesses: no biome, food or creature treats you differently.
dakura_origins.race.humano.trait.2: The classic Minecraft experience, with no shortcuts and no strings attached.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.name: Vampiric
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.epithet: The Hunger that Smiles in the Dark
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.descriptio: They do not hunt out of hunger: they hunt because they enjoy it. Vampirics are the smile that opens in the dark, the cold breath on your neck, the embrace that never lets go. Faster and stronger than any mortal, they see through the night as if it belonged to them and close their own wounds before the blood grows cold. But the sun tears them apart, and common food turns to ash in their mouths. Only blood sustains them, and when the thirst runs dry, all their glory rots along with it.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.trait.2: Accelerated regeneration of their own wounds.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.trait.3: Sunlight burns the flesh. Rain, water and shade protect.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.trait.4: Feeds only on blood: common food is rejected.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.trait.5: With an empty hunger bar, loses every gift of the race.
Seizes the prey in front of you in a predatory embrace and drinks its life for 1.5 s, healing you and sating your hunger. Monster blood is rotten: it poisons.
Dissolves into smoke and becomes a bat: free flight with no time limit. Press again to turn back.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.name: Draconic
dakura_origins.race.draconica.epithet: The Beast that Will Not Share the Sky
dakura_origins.race.draconica.descriptio: Draconics are not born: they hatch, already starving and already at war. They are mountains of scale and muscle that loathe walls, ceilings and any voice but their own. They forge no alliances, beg no forgiveness and never forget an insult. Fire is their cradle, meat their only food, and every enemy slain makes them grow, taller, harder and crueler, until the sky itself seems too small for them.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.0: Colossal body: starts at 2.5 blocks and grows up to 3.5 as it matures.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.1: Natural plating equal to a full set of iron armor, and far more health.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.2: Child of the heat: immune to fire and lava, and regenerates inside the flames.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.3: Superior brute strength. Health, plating, strength and ability damage rise with every stage.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.5: Too big for armor: instead, it matures by slaying monsters.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.6: Without about 6 free blocks overhead, it becomes slow, hungry and trembling.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.7: Does not use experience: the bar shows its maturity.
Hurls a sphere of draconic fire that explodes with the force of TNT and sets the area ablaze.
Raises a claw and slams down with all its weight: the shockwave hurls everything within 4 blocks into the air and deals heavy damage.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.name: Specter
dakura_origins.race.espectro.description: It died, but it never left. The Specter is the soul that refused to move on: the shape at the end of the hallway, the chill that seeps through the wall, the eyes watching you in the dark when you swear you are alone. It feels no hunger, needs no light, and monsters let it pass as if it were already one of them. When death comes for it again, it simply refuses to go. But water dissolves it, the Nether claims what is its own, and everything that heals the living burns what is left of it.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.0: Already dead: it feels no hunger and never needs to eat.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.2: A little stronger than a human, but frailer: only 8 hearts.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.3: Monsters don't attack it unless it strikes first.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.4: Second Chance (passive): when it dies, it stays standing with 1 heart and light regeneration. 5-minute cooldown.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.5: Water dissolves it: rain and oceans deal heavy damage.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.6: The Nether is hell: there it unravels just like in the rain.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.7: Healing potions and positive effects hurt it; negative effects make it stronger.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.ability.0.d: Turns invisible and passes through walls, like a spectator, with no time limit. Press again to become visible.
dakura_origins.race.driade.name: Dryad
dakura_origins.race.driade.epithet: The Nymph Who Hears the Roots
dakura_origins.race.driade.description: Dryads are nymphs of nature, born of sap and dew. They do not see with their eyes; they feel the world through roots, wind and the warmth of the sun on their skin. They are peaceful with those who respect the forest and merciless with those who wound it. Where they walk, plants grow; where they fall, flowers bloom. But fire consumes them, the Nether burns them alive, and the forest itself punishes, without mercy, any dryad who dares to fell a tree.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.0: A slender 2.5-block body, stronger and tougher than a human.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.1: Photosynthesis: under the sun it regenerates faster and its hunger fills on its own.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.4: Immune to poison, wither and the thorns of bushes.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.5: Completely blind, and it won't eat meat.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.6: At night it grows a little weaker.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.7: Breaking a tree is betrayal: the forest kills it on the spot.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.8: Fire deals double damage, and in the Nether it catches fire.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.9: When it dies, flowers sprout across the ground around it.
dakura_origins.race.driade.ability.0.des: Vines race across the ground to the enemy, bind its feet to the earth and leave it very slow.
dakura_origins.race.driade.ability.1.des: Only by day, under open sky: raises its arms, gathers sunlight and fires a ray that burns whoever stands ahead and breaks blocks.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.name: Elf
dakura_origins.race.elfo.epithet: One Who Measures Time in Centuries
dakura_origins.race.elfo.description: Elves live so long that human years pass them like seasons. Light, watchful and patient, they cross forests without snapping a twig and land an arrow where others can barely see the target. They are neither strong nor sturdy, and blasts and thunder wound their sensitive ears. But anyone who has hunted beside an elf knows: it senses danger long before anyone else, and is already gone when the blow lands.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.0: Light steps: faster, and falls from greater heights unharmed.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.1: Born archer: arrows and other projectiles deal 50% more damage.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.2: Long-lived: hunger drops at half the pace.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.3: Frail body: 9 hearts and weaker blows.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.4: Sensitive ears: explosions deal double damage.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.5: Refined palate: refuses rotten flesh, spider eyes and poisonous potatoes.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.ability.0.name: Nimble Retreat
dakura_origins.race.elfo.ability.0.descr: Leaps backward in the blink of an eye and gains a brief burst of speed.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.ability.1.name: Hunter's Gaze
dakura_origins.race.elfo.ability.1.descr: For 10 seconds, sees the outline of every creature within 40 blocks, even through walls.
dakura_origins.message.dryad_betrayal: The forest judged you for betrayal.
dakura_origins.message.elf_food: That is far too revolting for an elf.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.name: Huli Jing
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.descriptio: Huli Jing are fire foxes who learned to walk among people, but never to like them. Petty, suspicious and antisocial, they share nothing: not food, not shelter, not one word more than needed. They vanish when they please, trick whoever insists and burn whoever touches them. Only the world's foxes treat her like family, and they are the only company she tolerates.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.0: Stronger than a human, but with only 8 hearts.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.2: Immune to fire; every hit, with any weapon, sets the enemy ablaze.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.3: Silent footsteps; after standing still for 3 seconds she turns invisible and no monster notices her.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.4: Foxes don't flee from her and even follow her for a while.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.5: No effect works on her, good or bad (not even golden apples).
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.7: Can't swim: water doesn't hurt her, but she sinks.
Turns into a fire fox with no time limit: faster, jumps higher, regenerates and leaves a trail of fire. Press again to turn back.
Summons 3 illusions of herself, with her weapon and armor, that hunt the nearest enemy or whoever she hits, with fire strikes. They last 7 seconds.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing_neve.name: Snow Huli Jing
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing_neve.epith: The Fox Who Won't Share the Winter
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing_neve.descr: A Huli Jing born of snow: as beautiful as she is cold, and as petty as any other. She shares no food, shelter or attention, and fades into the white when anyone comes near. Her illusions freeze those who cross her, and her trail is frost. Distrustful, solitary and too proud to ask for help, she prefers the company of foxes to that of any person.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing_neve.trait: Stronger than a human, but with only 8 hearts.
Immune to frost and walks on powder snow; every hit, with any weapon, slows the enemy.
Silent footsteps; after standing still for 3 seconds she turns invisible and no monster notices her.
Foxes don't flee from her and even follow her for a while.
No effect works on her, good or bad (not even golden apples).
Can't swim: water doesn't hurt her, but she sinks.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing_neve.abili: Turns into a snow fox with no time limit: faster, jumps higher, regenerates and leaves a trail of frost. Press again to turn back.
Summons 3 illusions of herself, with her weapon and armor, that hunt the nearest enemy or whoever she hits, with frost strikes. They last 7 seconds.
dakura_origins.option.race_cosmetics.too: Races' ears, horns, wings, feathers, flower crown, translucency and slim body. Size and height always stay on.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.name: Goat
dakura_origins.race.cabra.description: Mountain satyrs who inherited everything from the goat: sure hooves, hard horns and thick wool. They live on snowy peaks, where no fall frightens them and no cold can reach them. Stubborn and tireless, they only rest up high, close to the sky.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.trait.0: Tougher than a human, with the same strength and health.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.trait.3: Hooves walk on powder snow and magma blocks unharmed.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.trait.4: Wool guards against cold and heat: immune to freezing, and fire hurts less.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.trait.6: Eats only plants, and each food fills less.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.trait.7: Can only sleep up high (above height 100).
dakura_origins.race.cabra.ability.0.name: Mountain Leap
dakura_origins.race.cabra.ability.0.desc: Hold the key to charge and release to jump, like a horse, but much higher. The more charge, the higher and farther.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.ability.1.name: Headbutt
dakura_origins.race.cabra.ability.1.desc: Charges with the horns and sends the first target ahead flying far away.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.name: Minotaur
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.descriptio: Bull-headed giants raised in stone labyrinths. Slow and heavy, but every blow brings walls down. They hate being cornered, and when they truly bleed the fury takes over: snorting smoke, they grow even stronger.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.trait.0: 2.5 blocks tall, great strength and great toughness.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.trait.1: Breaks blocks much faster, and hunger drops slowly.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.trait.3: Gets slow and restless in cramped places.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.trait.4: Vegetarian, and each food fills less.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.trait.5: Can't wear a helmet because of the horns.
Passive: at 4 hearts or less it flies into a rage, with strong regeneration and much more strength, snorting white smoke. Ends once it recovers.
Rips a large stone block from the ground and hurls it where you aim: it explodes on impact and scatters shards.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.name: Gargoyle
dakura_origins.race.gargula.description: Statues that magic awoke. Their flesh is stone, their blood is enchantment, and their small rock wings truly fly. They neither eat nor drink: when they need strength, they stand still and become a statue again until the body mends.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.0: Same health as a human, but far tougher and stronger.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.1: Truly flies with stone wings (double jump to take off).
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.2: Standing still on the ground for 5 seconds, turns into a statue and recovers health and hunger.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.3: Immune to knockback and fire, and never drowns.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.4: Can't eat anything (in exchange, hunger drops slowly).
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.5: Sinks in water and can't swim.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.ability.0.de: Passive: hits of more than 5 hearts lose 3 hearts of damage.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.ability.1.de: Leaps sky-high, turns to stone and plummets: the impact hurts everything around, without launching anyone. No fall damage.
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.name: Undead
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.epithet: The One Who Returned for Revenge
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.descripti: Died, but refused to accept it. The soul crawled back into its own body and now only wants to settle the score. It doesn't eat or rest, and the world's dead recognize it as one of their own. Every monster it fells strengthens the army it raises from the ground.
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.trait.1: Zombies, skeletons and other undead ignore it, unless it attacks.
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.trait.3: Killing monsters strengthens its zombies, in 4 levels (instead of experience).
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.trait.6: Healing potions and powers harm it.
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.ability.0: Raises 5 chainmail zombies that attack whoever you attack (or whoever attacks you) for 30 seconds. At higher levels they get swords and better armor, up to enchanted iron.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.name: Demon
dakura_origins.race.demonio.description: Creatures of darkness that live by tricking and bargaining with humans. They smile at the deal and collect later. Monsters recognize them and keep away, and the Nether welcomes them like home. But the gleam of an enchantment wounds them like nothing else.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.0: More strength and speed than a human; even stronger in the Nether.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.1: Big discount with villagers, which shrinks every time you hit them.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.2: Monsters won't attack it unless it attacks first.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.3: The closer to death, the more it regenerates.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.5: Enchanted weapons deal much more damage to it, and it can't use or wear anything enchanted.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.6: Poison, hunger and decay hurt it more.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.ability.0.de: Charms the target you aim at and makes it follow you without attacking. Normal-sized monsters, villagers and animals stay charmed with no limit; others for just 3 seconds.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.ability.1.de: Keeps the last creature you killed. Tap to become it (and again to change back); hold to release the stored form. Flyers can fly and water creatures breathe underwater.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.name: Vastaya Bird
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.description: A people who carry the spirit of wild beasts. Bound to the forest and wary of humankind, they are faster and stronger than any human, and among the trees they vanish completely: no footsteps, no name, no trail. Those of bird blood strike with bursts of cutting feathers.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.trait.0: Faster and stronger than a human; falls barely hurt.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.trait.2: In forests: silent steps, no name above the head, hidden from radars, and monsters won't attack unless attacked first.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.ability.0.de: For 10 seconds, senses monsters and players near and far (up to 48 blocks), even through walls.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.ability.1.de: Fires cutting feathers for 3 seconds; they stick like arrows, and each consecutive hit on the same target hurts more.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_felina.name: Vastaya Feline
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_felina.descr: A people who carry the spirit of wild beasts. Bound to the forest and wary of humankind, they are faster and stronger than any human, and among the trees they vanish completely: no footsteps, no name, no trail. Those of feline blood run and leap like no other.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_felina.trait: Faster and stronger than a human; falls barely hurt.
In forests: silent steps, no name above the head, hidden from radars, and monsters won't attack unless attacked first.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_felina.abili: For 10 seconds, senses monsters and players near and far (up to 48 blocks), even through walls.
For 8 seconds runs very fast, makes huge leaps and takes no fall damage.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_cao.name: Vastaya Hound
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_cao.descript: A people who carry the spirit of wild beasts. Bound to the forest and wary of humankind, they are faster and stronger than any human, and among the trees they vanish completely: no footsteps, no name, no trail. Those of wolf blood hunt in a frenzy, growling.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_cao.trait.0: Faster and stronger than a human; falls barely hurt.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_cao.trait.2: In forests: silent steps, no name above the head, hidden from radars, and monsters won't attack unless attacked first.
For 10 seconds, senses monsters and players near and far (up to 48 blocks), even through walls.
Enters hunting mode for 10 seconds: growls, gets stronger and faster.
dakura_origins.message.passive: This ability is passive: it works on its own.
dakura_origins.message.sleep_high: You can only sleep up high (above height %s).
dakura_origins.message.no_helmet: Your horns don't fit in a helmet.
dakura_origins.message.stone_diet: Stone doesn't eat. Stand still to regain your strength.
dakura_origins.message.no_enchanted: The enchantment's gleam burns your hands.
dakura_origins.message.need_ground: You need to stand firmly on the ground.
dakura_origins.message.morph_empty: No stored form. Kill a creature first.
dakura_origins.message.undead_grow: ✦ The dead answer your call with more strength.
